name: medical-syndicates-platform
description: Root scripts for local development (PROMPT.md §32). Mirrors the Makefile.

scripts.migrate: docker compose exec backend python manage.py migrate
scripts.makemigrations: docker compose exec backend python manage.py makemigrations
scripts.seed: docker compose exec backend python manage.py seed_dev_data
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: docker compose exec backend ruff check . && docker compose exec backend ruff format --check .
scripts.lint:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run rtl:check
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run test && npm --prefix frontend run build
